consts.name: dgcComBaseDie
consts.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 13): the base roll is 3d6 - a raw 3 to 18 range before the Charisma adjustment

consts.name: dgcComHumanMin
consts.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 13): the human Comeliness floor - the -2 after the Charisma ladder

consts.name: dgcComHumanMax
consts.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 13): the human Comeliness ceiling after the Charisma ladder

consts.name: dgcComRacialKorobokuru
consts.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 13): the korobokuru racial Comeliness adjustment

consts.name: dgcComRacialHengeyokai
consts.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 13): the hengeyokai racial Comeliness adjustment

consts.name: dgcComRacialSpiritFolk
consts.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 13): the spirit folk racial Comeliness adjustment

consts.name: dgcBandHorrorMax
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 13): the -16-or-lower horror band - repulsion, destruction or escape; evil viewers of an evil creature read the negative total as positive

consts.name: dgcBandDisgustMax
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 13): the -15-to--9 disgust band - revilement and hostility, no acceptance unless all are evil

consts.name: dgcBandAversionMax
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the -8-to-0 aversion band - rejection, hostility if provoked

consts.name: dgcBandUglyMax
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the +1-to-+6 ugly band - unease; high Charisma can offset through conversation

consts.name: dgcBandHomelyMax
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the +7-to-+9 homely band - a bad first impression, quickly overcome by high Charisma

consts.name: dgcBandPlainMax
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the +10-to-+13 plain band - no effect on others

consts.name: dgcBandGoodlookingMin
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the +14-to-+17 good-looking band - watch and stare; add the Comeliness score to the reaction roll; the opposite sex smitten at Wisdom 50 percent or less of the Comeliness score

consts.name: dgcBandGoodlookingMax
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the top of the good-looking band

consts.name: dgcBandBeautifulMin
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the +18-to-+21 beautiful band - heads turn and hearts race

consts.name: dgcBandBeautifulMax
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the top of the beautiful band

consts.name: dgcBandBeautifulPct
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the beautiful band adds 150 percent of the Comeliness score to the initial reaction roll

consts.name: dgcBandStunningMin
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the +22-to-+25 stunning band - people flock and behave outrageously to attract attention

consts.name: dgcBandStunningMax
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the top of the stunning band

consts.name: dgcBandUnearthlyMin
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the +28-to-+30 unearthly band - only creatures from other planes: demi-gods and unusual deities

consts.name: dgcBandUnearthlyMax
consts.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the top of the unearthly band

consts.name: dgcComPolymorphCap
consts.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 15): polymorph spells adjust the subject Comeliness by only two points - the subtle non-visual social clues

bools.name: dgcDexPrime
bools.comment: Dexterity prose (capture pp. 8-9): the ninja prime requisite - Dex 16 or higher earns the 10 percent experience bonus

bools.name: dgcDexMissileAndSurprise
bools.comment: Dexterity prose (capture p. 9): the reaction/attacking adjustment applies to missile-fire to-hit rolls and to both sides of a surprise situation (capturing and being captured)

bools.name: dgcDexDefensiveDodge
bools.comment: Dexterity prose (capture p. 9): the defensive adjustment applies to dodgable saving throws (fireballs, lightning bolts, boulders) and modifies Armor Class - the Ieyasu haramaki-do example: AC 6 modified to 4 at Dex 16, to 8 at Dex 5

bools.name: dgcConRevivalLimit
bools.comment: Constitution prose (capture p. 9): the initial Constitution score is the absolute limit on revivals - each raise or resurrection reduces Constitution by one (the printed Ieyasu example: Con 12 allows 12 revivals)

bools.name: dgcConRestoreNoRefund
bools.comment: Constitution prose (capture p. 9): magic can restore a reduced Constitution score but has no effect on the revival count - the original score binds; only a wish revives past the limit

bools.name: dgcConShockSecondRoll
bools.comment: Constitution prose (capture p. 10): the system shock roll repeats on the return polymorph - surviving the change does not survive the change back

bools.name: dgcConResurrectionFail
bools.comment: Constitution prose (capture p. 10): a failed resurrection survival roll is final - the character is irrevocably dead regardless of prior revivals

bools.name: dgcIntPrime
bools.comment: Intelligence prose (capture p. 11): the wu jen prime requisite - Int 16 or higher earns the 10 percent experience bonus

bools.name: dgcIntSpellGate
bools.comment: Intelligence prose (capture p. 11): the wu jen Intelligence gates which spells he can learn and how many he can remember; only the highest Intelligence comprehends 9th-level spells

bools.name: dgcWisPrime
bools.comment: Wisdom prose (capture p. 11): the shukenja prime requisite - Wis 16 or higher earns the 10 percent experience bonus

bools.name: dgcWisBonusSpells
bools.comment: Wisdom prose (capture p. 11): shukenja and sohei with Wisdom 13 or higher gain bonus spells over their normal allowance

bools.name: dgcChaHenchmenPaid
bools.comment: Charisma prose (capture p. 12): the maximum henchmen is an absolute limit on permanent unpaid companions; killed or mistreated henchmen cannot be replaced; paid servitors are unaffected

bools.name: dgcComCharismaTracks
bools.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 13): Comeliness tracks Charisma point-for-point through disease, disfigurement, aging and magic

bools.name: dgcComRacialOtherRaceOnly
bools.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 13): the racial Comeliness adjustments apply only when interacting with characters of other races

bools.name: dgcBandGoodlookingReactionAdd
bools.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the good-looking band adds the Comeliness score itself to the percentile reaction roll

bools.name: dgcBandBeautifulSmitten
bools.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): in the beautiful band the opposite sex is smitten unless Wisdom exceeds two-thirds of the Comeliness score; the same sex unless Wisdom is at least 50 percent

bools.name: dgcBandRejectionHalfNegative
bools.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): a harsh rejection in the beautiful band makes the rejected react as if the Comeliness were a negative score of half the actual positive total

bools.name: dgcBandStunningReactionTwice
bools.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): the stunning band reaction adjustment is twice the Comeliness score - the printed Comeliness 22 equals +44 example

bools.name: dgcBandStunningSmitten
bools.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): in the stunning band anyone whose Wisdom is less than two-thirds of the Comeliness score is smitten; a purposefully sought opposite-sex target is smitten unless Wisdom is 18 or more

bools.name: dgcBandUnearthlySave
bools.comment: Comeliness bands (capture p. 14): in the unearthly band the looks affect everyone except viewers with Wisdom at least 75 percent of the Comeliness score; Wisdom 19 or more earns a saving throw; a sought opposite-sex target escapes only at Wisdom 20 or more

bools.name: dgcSmittenFascinate
bools.comment: the smitten doctrine (capture p. 14): a smitten creature acts as if under the 2nd-level illusionist spell fascinate (Unearthed Arcana) - trusted friend and companion; a successful saving throw vs. spell negates

bools.name: dgcSmittenNonmagical
bools.comment: the smitten doctrine (capture p. 14): if the Comeliness is not magical, dispel magic and anti-magic spells do not affect the fascination

bools.name: dgcSmittenOrderRoll
bools.comment: the smitten doctrine (capture p. 14): a smitten creature follows orders if 3d6 does not exceed the Comeliness score; contrary-to-interest orders gain a modifier; hazardous orders up to +6 or more; a higher roll breaks the effect

bools.name: dgcSmittenNotPuppet
bools.comment: the smitten doctrine (capture p. 15): being smitten does not affect fighting or spellcasting ability, nor reduce the target to a zombie or a puppet - alignment still guides; contrary instructions allow a +3 or +4 modifier to break the effect

bools.name: dgcSmittenBadTreatmentNegative
bools.comment: the smitten doctrine (capture p. 14): a badly treated creature that breaks free reacts as if the Comeliness were negative; a well-treated one may stay friendly after the effect fades

bools.name: dgcComTemporary
bools.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 14): the high-Comeliness effect is temporary - once known, Comeliness is negated and Charisma determines reactions and followers (beauty is only skin deep)

bools.name: dgcComIllusionCapOne
bools.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 15): illusion spells raise or lower Comeliness by at most one point; illusions of high-Comeliness figures last a single round - the high Comeliness focuses attention and weakens the illusion

bools.name: dgcComShapechangeFull
bools.comment: Comeliness prose (capture p. 15): shapechange confers the full Comeliness effects of the final form

banner.title: THE ABILITY PROSE, printed capture pp. 8-15 - the OA Chapter 1 prose round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 8-15 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). ADJUDICATIONS: the capture prints the Comeliness bands with two holes - no 26-27 band exists between the stunning +25 top and the unearthly +28 floor, and the bands print contiguous otherwise; both pinned as printed, flagged for the physical copy. The smitten doctrine prints the fascinate equation with the +t contrary-interest modifier read as the plus-one-class hazard ladder (up to +6 or more at the extreme) - pinned as the printed ladder. The reaction-band reaction-adds (score, 150 percent, twice) pin as the printed multipliers.
